content: TAMBANA VAT NDINYANGU KAT ANA KWUNATNDƗ KRAIST MƗNA

Tamba Juda Moses kwiya nyaangɨtmba God kat kwunatɨnja vak kɨngian. Naambi naambi God tɨga kava wuleilaa God kat kwunatɨndi. Kwunatɨnja vak ndina maawut ana apma vat tɨndɨ. Wan tamba yilɨnja vak ngɨni yaiga apma vak kat vɨsɨmogwilɨndɨ.

Wan tamba yilɨnja vat Godna nɨmbana maawut apma vat tɨgendan wan vak ngɨni naambi naambi ana yilɨgendi. Wan vak ndina maawut kwunatɨgendan ngɨni nɨna maawupmba lɨga kavle vak kat God kat kwunakiyanɨn waa ana kwunatɨgendi.
Kwunatɨnja vak ngi vak ana ndɨ. Kwunatɨnja vak kat yiga kavle vat yetɨnja vak nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨndi. Yelavɨtsɨmbla lɨndi.
God kat kwunapmak kwinja kaala bulmakau memena yelogwen ana alɨpsɨga ndu nyan kat kwunakiyandɨ. Ana ndi kat apma maawut kwigiyandɨ.
Kraist kan kɨpma ngaga yavat tɨga God kat wandɨ. Ambugatna nda kwiga kwanda kwanda nda vatnyalaa mɨn kat kwunapmat yilɨnja vak kat kai wamɨn. Mɨn kat kwunapmat kwiweya mbangɨ wun kat awagapma kwimɨn.
Mɨn kat kwunapmat kwanda kwanda nda kat vatnyalaa yamba tulaa kwivat yilɨnja vak kat ana woviyaguga lɨgamɨn.
God, mɨnai yelavɨk vapmba njɨvwa kwupmat tamba yawun. Wan kwupmat yawa vat tamba la nɨmba pɨlɨwutndi.

Kraist waa nyaangɨtna angwa kɨngiyan. Ndɨ wandɨ. God kat ambugatna nda kwiga kwanda kwanda nda vatnyalaa yamba tulaa kwunapmat yilɨnja vak kat God kai wandɨ waa wandɨ Kraist. God wan tamb la Juda Moses kwiya nyaangɨtmba yinja vak kat ana woviyaguga lɨndɨ.
Nat samat vat wandɨ. God mɨnai yelavɨk vapmba njɨvwa kwupmat tamba yawun waa wandɨ Kraist. Manda kat wupma wandɨ. Tamba la vak kat nglɨndangat wandɨ. Mandɨt kupi vat taagavat wandɨ.

Wan mandɨt kupi vapmba God wandɨ maa Jisas Kraist nɨn kat tɨga Godna nyingi maawut kɨta njambɨ aywaa kwunatndɨ. kwunatndɨ maa God nɨn kat vɨlaa kavle vat yilɨna vak ana vɨlɨgandɨ. Ndi apma nɨmba ndi waa vɨga lɨgandɨ.
KRAIST GOD KAT KƗTA NJAMBƗ MƗNA KWUNATNDƗ
Wan kɨpmamba la God kat kwunata nɨmba ndi nandinya nandinya nɨma sakwat njambɨ wuleilaa God kat kwunapmak kwilɨndi. Wan kwilɨnja vat yilɨna kavle vak kat ana sɨlɨmbwilɨndɨ.
Kraist wupma ana yilɨndɨ. Mandɨt apma vatna yilɨnda. Ndɨ kɨta njambɨ mɨna ndɨna mbangɨ God kat kwunapmat kwindɨ. Kwilaa njɨvwa kwagalalaa yiga Godna yaagindannaangɨmba ndaalɨga yat njawia lɨgandɨ.
Ndaalɨga kawiga lɨgandɨ. Ndɨna maama nɨmba kat God ndɨ kat walaa sɨndangat kawiga lɨgandɨ.
Kraist kɨta njambɨ ndɨna mbangɨ Godnat aywaa kwidɨ maa ndɨna mbaapma nɨmba aywaa mandɨt kupi maawut tamba klandi.
Godna waagan ngwuk kat wawa nyaangɨt ndɨno nɨn kat tamba wandɨ. Ngɨni yaiga kupi vak kat wandɨ maa tamba pɨlɨwutndi.

Wan ngɨni yaiga njɨmbla yandɨ maa nat mandɨt kupi nyaangɨt ndi kat mbukiyowun. wunai yila vak kat ndia maawupmba yelavɨka yetɨgiyandi. Ana kwagalagiyandi. Ndinai yelavɨkiya vak wuna yelavɨk vapmba yetigiyandi.
Kavle vat yilɨnja vak kat ana yelavɨka vɨga lɨgiyowun waa njambi nyan wandɨ waa tamba pɨlɨwutndi.
Njambwi nyan yilɨna kavle vak kat vɨga yelavɨtapman tɨlɨgandɨ. Ngi kat tɨga nɨn ana ndɨ kat kwunakiyanɨn. Nyingi maawut kai.
GOD KAT ANA VAAKIYANƗN
Kɨta mbaapma nɨmba nɨn God tɨga kava nɨma njambia lɨga kava wuleilɨganɨn. Wuleivak kat ana vaakiyanɨn. Jisas kiyalaa ndɨna yelogwen salatndan wuleineya yambɨ tamba kwutndɨ.

Wan wuleineya yambɨ mandɨt kupi yamba. Apma vapmba yiga yetɨneya yamba. Kraist wan yambɨ nɨn kat tɨga kwutndɨ, lɨgandɨ. Tamba la Juda sel lavwilaa God tɨga ngay wuleindi. Kraist kiyalaa nyinangwut wuleineya yambɨ kwutndɨ. Ndɨna mbangɨ tamba la sel vla lɨgandɨ.
Kɨta mbaapma nɨmba, nɨn kat tɨga God kat kwunakna nyan ngilɨga. Ndɨna sɨ Jisas.

Ngi kat tɨga God tɨga kava wuleivak kat ana vaakiyanɨn. Nɨn kat tɨga Godna nyingi maawut Kraist kwunakna vat vɨlɨganɨn. Kraist nɨn kat apma kupi maawut tamba kwindɨ. Kwindɨ maa kupi maawupmba yelavɨka yetɨganɨn. God nɨn kat yilɨna kavle vak kat ana sɨgiyandɨ waa yelavɨka yetɨganɨn. Nɨnamba lɨga nglambi tamba ndɨna apma ngumba njangindɨ, wan nglambi ngɨlɨndɨ. Ngi kat tɨga God tɨga kava wuleivak kat ana vaakiyanɨn.
God waa nyaangɨt ngwula maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨngwa vak ke kwagalaga. God ngwuk kat apma vat yigiyowun waa tamba wandɨ. Woseka ana wandɨ. yigiyandɨ.
Ngwulogwinala kɨta mbaapma nɨmba ngwutna maawut awat sowat kwunak ngwula. Kwunakngwuk maa nat nɨmba kat apma maawut yelavɨka yiga kwuakiyandi.

Ngwutna nat nɨmba Godna mbaapma nɨmbonala yisoga lɨvak kat kai walɨgandi. Ngwuk wupma ke yiga. Kɨta vat yisolaa lɨga awat sowat nyaangɨt ambuk ngwula. Njambwi nyan yaiga nandinya tamba ngway tolagandɨ. Ngi kat tɨga wan wawa vat nɨmamba kwutaa alɨ ngwula.
GOD WAA NYAANGƗT KWAGALANEYAN KAVLE YIGIYANƗN
God waa nyaangɨt maawupmba yelavɨka kwutaa lɨna nyaangɨt kai waa kwagalaneyan Godna nyingi maawut kwunakiya vak kai.
Ndɨna nyingi maawut tɨga vat ngɨni nɨn kat yalaa sɨgiyandɨ. Nɨn vaaka kawiga lɨgiyanɨn. Ndɨ kat kai walɨga nɨmba aywaa yandeya njɨmbla ndi kat aywaa sɨndɨ maa ngɨlɨgiyandi.
Moses ta njɨmbla wan vat tɨndɨ. Moses kwiya nyaangɨt kat kai waa nɨmba vlɨlɨlɨk palɨ kuvut nɨmba kai wanja vak kat vɨlaa ndi kat sɨndi. Ndi kat kavle vat yandɨ.

Mbambala kɨta nyan Godna nyan kwuta njɨvwa kat kai walaa Kraist wun kat tɨga kwiya yelogwen kavle nda waa walaa Godna waagan kavle nda ana nɨn kat kwunatɨgandɨ waa wandeya wan nyan kat nɨma nglei kavle vat yaigandɨ. Moses kwiya nyaangɨt kat kaiwaa nyan kat kavle ya vat nɨma nglei vatna.
Tamba God waa nyaangɨt wuka lɨganɨn. Kɨta nyan wun kat kai wandeyan ndɨ kat sɨgiyowun waa God wandɨ. Nat njambɨ wandɨ. Wuna wandɨ God.
God ana wundumbu yindɨ. Kwo lɨgandɨ. Ngi kat tɨga nɨn kat sɨvat wandeyan kavle glei vatna. Nɨn vaaka lɨgiyanɨn.
MAAWUPMBA YELAVƗKA KWUTAA LƗNGWA VAK KE KWAGALAGA
Tat wan apma nyaangɨt wutaa kwutaa yetɨngwut maa nat nɨmba ngwuk kat waleavat kavle vat ngwuk kat yilɨndi. Wan njɨmbla apma kupi maawut klangwuk. Wan klangwa vat ngwula maawut ke tɨvɨga kwagalaga.
Nat nɨmba ngwuk kat njɨtɨndi. Nat nɨmba ngwuk kat kai walaa nɨma vat yilɨndi. Nat vatnolɨga nɨmba kat kwunatɨgwuk.

Tat wun kat kalabusmba taagandi maa wun kat nɨma maawut yelavɨka lɨga kwunatɨngwuk. Ngwuk kat kai walɨga nɨmba ngwutna kwanda kwanda nda sɨkwutndi maa ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨngwuk. Nɨma nda njɨmbla njɨmbla tɨgiyaa nda nyinangwupmba lɨgandɨ waa yelavɨtaa ana nɨmamba yelavɨka lɨngwuk.
Ngwuk kat nɨma vat yandɨ, God kat kwutaa lɨngwa vak ke kwagalaga. Wan vak kwagalalapman yingweyan God ngwuk kat apma vat yiga kwunakiyandɨ.
Tagula maawutno lɨga apma vat god waa njɨvwa kwuka lɨlɨngwa vak kwagalalapman yingweyan God ngwuk kat kwuankiyowun wandɨ. Wanda vla kwunakiyandɨ.
Tamba God wandɨ maa pɨlɨwutndi. Nɨn kat kwunatndeya njɨmbla sɨvla ana ndɨ. Nɨna njambwi nyan ya mɨna lɨgandɨ. Ana sɨvla kawiga lɨgiyandɨ.

Mbambala wuna mbaapma nɨmba ndi kat apma vat yiweya vak kat yelavɨka yetɨgiyandi. Wuna mbaapmana kɨta nyan wun kat kai waa kwagalandeyan ndɨ kat ana woviyaguga lɨgiyowun waa wandɨ God waa tamba pɨlɨwutndi.
God kat kai waa kwagalalaa kavle vat yilɨga nɨmba vla ana lɨganɨn. Godna apma nyaangɨt wutaa apma maawut klalaa apma vat yetɨlɨga nɨmba vla lɨganɨn.
